note: Explicit, pinned provisioning. scripts/provision_models.py downloads each artifact once, verifies sha256 (and upstream md5 where published), and writes data/models/<model>/PROVISIONED.json. Analysis and search never download. Hosts reachable from the 2026-09-30 build environment are recorded; Hugging Face and download.pytorch.org were blocked there (HTTP 403).

clip_vit_b32_laion2b_s34b_b79k.export: ONNX export published by Jina clip-as-service (clip_server 0.8.3 model table: 'ViT-B-32::laion2b-s34b-b79k')
clip_vit_b32_laion2b_s34b_b79k.preprocessing: RGB, bicubic resize, 224x224, mean=(0.48145466,0.4578275,0.40821073) std=(0.26862954,0.26130258,0.27577711); views defined in services/analyze/embeddings.py (PREPROCESS_VERSION)
clip_vit_b32_laion2b_s34b_b79k.tokenizer: OpenAI CLIP byte-level BPE (bpe_simple_vocab_16e6), context length 77
clip_vit_b32_laion2b_s34b_b79k.license: OpenCLIP code MIT; LAION-2B-trained weights released by LAION/OpenCLIP under MIT. LAION-2B is web-scraped; review dataset terms before commercial use.

minilm_l6_v2.export: ONNX export published by Qdrant fastembed (GCS bucket qdrant-fastembed)
minilm_l6_v2.normalization: mean pooling over attention mask, then l2
minilm_l6_v2.language_scope: English only; do not rely on it for Hindi/Arabic queries

efficientdet_lite0.ontology: COCO 2017 detection labels embedded in the TFLite metadata (read at load time, never assumed dense 0..79)
efficientdet_lite0.substitution_note: Replaces the prompt's torchvision ssdlite320_mobilenet_v3_large suggestion: download.pytorch.org was blocked (403) in the build environment. Same role: one small fixed-taxonomy COCO baseline.

blaze_face_short_range.architecture: BlazeFace short range (MediaPipe Tasks FaceDetector), float16

rapidocr_onnxruntime.package: rapidocr_onnxruntime==1.4.4 (PyPI wheel; models ship inside the wheel)
rapidocr_onnxruntime.language_scope: PP-OCRv4 'ch' recognizer: Simplified Chinese + Latin/English. Not Arabic/Devanagari.

unavailable.onejev: OmniJev/OneJev weights and server not provisionable: github.com and huggingface.co blocked (403) in the build environment. Typed context decisions use the documented CLIP zero-shot decision backend instead; see docs/architecture-decisions/ADR-005-context-decisions.md.
unavailable.faster_whisper_weights: Whisper CTranslate2 weights are fetched from Hugging Face by faster-whisper; blocked. The library installs, ASR stays unavailable until weights are provisioned elsewhere.
unavailable.multilingual_ocr: Arabic/Devanagari PP-OCRv5 recognizers not provisioned; those scripts are unsupported and shown as such.
